title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text: 3.Strongly condemns the attacks against all civilians carried out by the Rwanda-backed M23, as well as the ADF, and others armed groups in the eastern DRC, including killings, abductions, and destruction of religious property, and calls for an immediate halt to such acts of violence; expresses its solidarity with the families of the victims and all people of the DRC;
